proposals.name: Godot Engine 2D/3D Minimalist UI & Vector Asset Packs
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers migrating from Unity/Unreal to Godot who need rapid prototyping assets, UI kits, and clean vector icons that fit Godot's node-based architecture.
product_angles: Flat vector UI component sheets (buttons, frames, progress bars) optimized for Godot's Control Nodes
Pixel-art style 16x16 or 32x32 minimalist icon packs for inventory systems
Godot-theme preset files (.theme) bundled with SVG icons
proposals.first_test_product: Minimalist Sci-Fi Vector UI Kit (SVG + PNG) formatted for Godot 4.x

proposals.name: Solo Journaling RPGs & Tabletop Oracles
proposals.buyer_persona: Tabletop RPG enthusiasts who play solo, requiring highly atmospheric prompt decks, oracle books, and structured journaling templates to document their campaigns.
product_angles: Aesthetic KDP journaling notebooks with built-in creative prompts and random tables
Printable PDF oracle card decks with high-contrast, dark-fantasy line art
The Game Crafter (TGC) physical card decks featuring generative micro-dungeons and event prompts
proposals.first_test_product: The Solo Cartographer's Journal: A 120-page KDP notebook with hex-grid pages and random encounter tables

proposals.name: Rope Access Technicians & Cordistes (Industrial Climbing)
proposals.buyer_persona: Industrial rope access technicians (cordistes, wind turbine technicians, bridge inspectors) proud of their extreme, high-risk profession, sharing strong insider humor and technical jargon.
product_angles: Redbubble sticker packs with rope rigging humor, knot schematics, and 'gravity is a myth' slogans
KDP logbooks designed specifically for tracking industrial climbing hours, rigging configurations, and safety checks
Cults3D parametric STL files for rope protectors, carabiner organizers, or custom gear tags
proposals.first_test_product: Rope Access Hours Logbook: A pocket-sized KDP book for tracking work-at-height certifications and site hours

proposals.name: French Speleology & Cave Cartography Clubs
proposals.buyer_persona: Local French speleology clubs (FFS members), cave explorers, and cartographers who need ultra-durable gear organizers, surveying logs, and custom club merch.
product_angles: Cults3D 3D-printable custom brackets for cave-surveying lasers (DistoX) and helmet mounts
Water-resistant KDP surveying notebooks with specialized grid layouts for subterranean sketching
Redbubble apparel featuring localized French cave system maps and underground topography humor
proposals.first_test_product: 3D-Printable DistoX laser survey mount for speleo helmets (Cults3D STL)

proposals.name: Cytotechnologists & Medical Laboratory Scientists
proposals.buyer_persona: Lab technicians, pathologists, and cytotechnologists who spend hours looking through microscopes, possessing a highly specific dark humor about bodily fluids, microbes, and staining techniques.
product_angles: Aesthetic watercolor-style cell patterns (Mitosis, Gram-negative bacteria) on Redbubble apparel and phone cases
KDP 'Lab Error Log' or 'Slide Review Journal' with humorous covers and structured layout for daily lab notes
Vector sticker packs featuring cute but medically accurate pathogens (E. coli, Tardigrades, Lymphocytes)
proposals.first_test_product: Redbubble sticker pack: 'Gram-Negative & Fabulous' featuring stylized microscopic cell structures

proposals.name: Homebrewing & Craft Cider Maker Organizers
proposals.buyer_persona: Passionate homebrewers and artisanal cider makers who treat fermenting as a science, requiring precise logging of gravity, pH, hops schedule, and fermentation temperatures.
product_angles: Highly detailed KDP Brew Day logs with specialized fields for grain bills, mash schedules, and yeast pitch rates
Printable vintage-style vector labels for beer bottles (Etsy download/SVG)
3D-printable tap handles and airlock stabilizers for fermenters on Cults3D
proposals.first_test_product: The Craft Brewer's Brew Day Companion: A 150-batch brewing logbook with water chemistry calculators
